guarantee.meaning_of_pass: No unauthorized reachability counterexample was found.
guarantee.meaning_of_fail: An unauthorized role can reach a protected route.
guarantee.meaning_of_unknown: Encoding incomplete, solver unknown, or binary unavailable.

assumptions: Route and role abstractions faithfully represent the change under review.
limits: Native Z3 availability is optional; deterministic fallback is weaker.
failure_semantics: Validation failures and solver errors map to unknown/error.
unsupported_semantics: Does not reconstruct frameworks beyond the supplied route abstraction.
